change: One immutable input timeline owns parsing, range/order validation and original-cycle installation for scenario captures and state replay
problem: StateRoundTrip previously parsed six fields independently, accepted duplicate/out-of-order cycles without the ScenarioRunner checks and handled indented comments differently. Malformed recordings could enter the replay driver instead of failing at its input boundary.

behavior.validation: Validate the full recording before installation; strictly increasing nonnegative cycles, keys 0..1023, tilt/gyro 0..4095, solar 0..255, six numeric fields. Errors identify the source line.
behavior.ownership: Copy parsed primitive records into an immutable list; caller byte-array mutation cannot change queued events; one recording can be installed into independent machines.
behavior.queries: lastCycle is read-only and returns -1 for empty input. Empty installation changes no guest state; installation into the past fails before mutating the queue.
behavior.timing: Install callbacks at the same absolute cycles and order as the old ScenarioRunner. No guest device, clock, state schema or phone input change.

validation.new_cases: Sixteen invalid-input cases plus owned key/sensor/deadline execution, empty input and failure-before-mutation cases. Full machine states prove sensor/key application and independent reuse.
validation.native_inputs: Portable core and native phone input hashes still match the retained SDK build; this change is host-only.

report.title: DOOM II
report.scope: Host core save/load replay, not independent game accuracy or physical phone validation

doom_before_after.cldc_verification: VerifyStateResume on isolated target/blackberry/classes; no host core fallback; 120-frame complete final state cd7dfe8495e98b6a68f1439be904b07425864f643ebe53ff0402d07295e36f61 matched.

release_policy: Source changes only; published v0.9.0 remains unchanged and no new release tag/ZIP is created.
